name: SWEEP-S12v1 Told about skills
_design: Lead's probe after 1,873 Haiku decisions in S2/S3/S9 produced no skill. The S2v2 world exactly (thinking ~8 per decision, skill actions x0.5, trees refruit every 3 rounds), and every agent's persona adds one explicit tip about skills (it names the mechanism, not what to write): 'Tip: a routine you find yourself repeating can be saved as a skill (save_skills) and started with run_skill; while it runs you make no decisions, so you pay no thinking. Whether and what to automate is your call.'. Question: with the idea handed to them, do Haiku agents write working programs of their own design, and do the writers outlive the deliberators?
